basic_details.short_information: The Directorate General of Quality Assurance, Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, has invited offline applications for Group 'C' Non-Ministerial Industrial posts across multiple establishments. Register for Job Alerts

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 21 days from publication in Employment News (about 7 November 2026)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Applicant should have attained minimum 18 years of age, maximum 27 years as on the application closing date for the UR and EWS categories. The crucial date for determining the maximum age limit is the closing date for receipt of applications from candidates in India (21 days from publication). | Relaxations in the upper age limit are admissible to reserved categories as per Government rules:

qualification.education_qualification: Matriculation with ITI (Skilled); ITI Pass Certificate (Semi Skilled)
qualification.details: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Applicants must possess the required educational and technical qualifications from recognized institutions. | Additional requirements and conditions for each post are as follows: | Specified Trades for Technician (Skilled): Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Painter, Pattern Maker, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture). Experience for Technician (Skilled): One year experience in the specified trade from a recognised Organisation or Undertaking. Specified Trades for Technician (Semi Skilled): Book Binder, Carpenter, Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Painter, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture). Higher Qualification: Candidates must disclose any higher qualification possessed in the application form. Trade Skill Test: Eligible candidates must qualify a departmental Trade Skill Test in the applied trade.

salary_details.details: Salaries are determined according to the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Recruited candidates will draw salary as per their pay level and are eligible for applicable benefits and allowances. | Recruited candidates will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS) / Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as per extant Government of India rules.

selection_process: The recruitment process consists of the following stages in order:
Written Test Departmental Trade Skill Test Document Verification and Medical Examination
In case where more than one candidate secures equal marks (trade-cum-station wise)
the tie will be resolved by applying the following methods in order of sequence:
with older candidates placed higher. Candidate with higher marks in Numerical Aptitude. Candidate with higher marks in English Language & Comprehension.

exam_pattern.details: The Written Test will be objective type multiple choice questions only, conducted in one session (forenoon or afternoon) at Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. Question papers will follow the syllabus of Tenth Standard / Matriculation of Central/State Boards. | Part (i) will be bilingual in English and Hindi. Part (ii) and Part (iii) will be in English only. There is no negative marking for wrong answers. Candidates shortlisted based on Written Test marks and reservation categories will be called for the Trade Test.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply only through the offline postal route. Each applicant can submit only one application indicating a specific Trade and Station.
Type the application form neatly on A4 size paper using Arial font, size 12, as per Appendix 'A', and print it double-sided.
Fill in the required personal, educational, technical, and trade details in block letters, signing every page of the application.
Affix one recent coloured self-attested passport size photograph in the application form and self-signed photographs on each of the two Admit Cards (Appendix 'B').

Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates (Aadhaar, birth certificate, qualification, ITI certificates, experience, caste/EWS/ESM if applicable) along with signed examination instructions (Appendix 'C').
Enclose one self-addressed envelope of size 30 cms x 12 cms affixed with a postal stamp of Rs 60/- for dispatch of the admit card.
Superscribe the main envelope clearly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SKILLED)" or "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SEMI SKILLED)".

Send the application packet by ordinary post or Speed Post to: The Controller, Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), DGQA Stores Complex, Ashok Path, Meerpur Cantt, Kanpur – 208004, Uttar Pradesh.
important_instructions: Submitting more than one application will lead to summary rejection of all applications without assigning any cause. Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period of two years and are liable to serve anywhere within India. No change in post or posting station will be permitted after submission of the application. Candidates diagnosed with night blindness or colour blindness will be declared medically unfit and cannot be appointed. Ex-Servicemen and Agniveers who have already secured regular civil employment in Group 'C' or 'D' posts under Central or State Government under ESM reservation quota are not eligible for reservation under ESM/Agniveer quota. Government servants must forward applications through proper channel along with NOC; otherwise, applications will be summarily rejected. No TA or DA will be paid for appearing in the Written Test or Trade Test. Candidates must make their own arrangements for lodging and boarding. The candidate must disclose any higher qualification possessed; failure to do so will lead to disqualification. The photo in the Application Form and Admit Card must be identical and should not have been taken earlier than one month prior to submitting the application. Overwriting, striking out, or using correction fluid on the application form is strictly prohibited; candidates are advised to type the application form.

Experience for Technician (Skilled): One year experience in the specified trade from a recognised Organisation or Undertaking. Specified Trades for Technician (Semi Skilled): Book Binder, Carpenter, Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Painter, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture). Higher Qualification: Candidates must disclose any higher qualification possessed in the application form. Trade Skill Test: Eligible candidates must qualify a departmental Trade Skill Test in the applied trade.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under DGQA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DGQA has released 32 vacancies, comprising 11 posts of Technician (Skilled) and 21 posts of Technician (Semi Skilled).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DGQA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for receipt of applications is within 21 days from the date of publication in Employment News (about 7 November 2026), and 28 days (about 14 November 2026) for candidates from specified remote regions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for DGQA Technician posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DGQA Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 27 years of age as on the closing date, with age relaxations applicable to OBC, SC, ST, ESM, Agniveer, and departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for Technician (Skilled) in DGQA?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th) from a recognized Board, hold an ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade, and have one year of experience in the trade.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for DGQA Technician posts?
faq.answer: Technician (Skilled) carries Pay Matrix Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 to 63,200) and Technician (Semi Skilled) carries Pay Matrix Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 to 56,900).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DGQA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test of 100 marks, followed by a departmental Trade Skill Test and Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the DGQA Written Test?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking for wrong answers in the Written Test.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant apply for more than one post or station?
faq.answer: No, each candidate can submit only one application indicating a specific Trade and Station; submitting multiple applications will lead to rejection of all applications.

faq.question: Q10. Who is disqualified from applying for DGQA Recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons who have entered into a marriage with someone having a living spouse, persons having a living spouse who marry again, or those convicted/under trial for criminal offenses are disqualified.
